open-surround: Dolby Atmos for Headphones on PipeWire (Linux x86_64, prebuilt)
https://github.com/giacomomicoli/open-surround

This package does NOT include Dolby's module. Copy your own DolbyAudioProcessing.dll (from a
Windows install of Dolby Access) into this folder, next to the `open-surround` script.
Where to find it on Windows, and the verified version (DAP 7.3.7, SHA-256 0fada402...4e715):
https://github.com/giacomomicoli/open-surround#getting-the-dll

Requirements: PipeWire 1.2 or newer, glibc 2.39 or newer (Debian 13, Ubuntu 25.04, Fedora 41,
Arch and later). Ubuntu 24.04 has PipeWire 1.0, too old for the node.

Run without installing
    ./open-surround
  starts the node (sinks "open-surround 7.1 (giochi)" and "open-surround stereo
  (applicazioni)") and the settings window; closing the window stops the node.
    ./open-surround --senza-finestra      only the node, until Ctrl-C
    ./open-surround --dll /path/to/DolbyAudioProcessing.dll
  If the node is already running (for example as the installed service) it opens only the
  window.

Install into your home directory (node as a systemd user service, menu entry)
    ./install.sh                          uses the DLL copied into this folder, or else the
                                          copy already installed
    ./install.sh /path/to/DolbyAudioProcessing.dll
    systemctl --user enable --now open-surround
    ./install.sh --uninstall
  Same as dist/linux/install.sh in the repository, without building.

Updates: an install made with ./install.sh updates itself from the window ("Aggiorna"), or with
    os-update check
    os-update apply
  The package is verified with its minisign signature and SHA-256 before anything is replaced.

Then make "open-surround stereo" (applications) your default output, and send games with 7.1
output to "open-surround 7.1". Settings are kept in ~/.config/open-surround/settings.json,
shared by the two ways of running it.

Contents
    open-surround         launcher (node + window)
    install.sh            installer
    bin/                  os-pipewire (node), os-ui (window), os-ctl (control), os-blob,
                          os-update (updates)
    versione.json         version and commit of the package
    share/                systemd user unit and .desktop entry used by install.sh
